company_type: Indian industrial conglomerate flagship, integrated steel producer

technology.technology_name: Hydrogen-Compatible API X65 ERW Steel Pipes + Coke Oven Gas (COG) Injection at Blast Furnace
technology.description: Tata Steel became India's first steel company (Jan 2025) to develop hydrogen-compliant API X65 grade ERW pipes capable of carrying 100% pure gaseous H2 at 100 bar. Steel made at Kalinganagar plant, pipes processed at Khopoli plant; hydrogen qualification tests done at RINA-CSM S.p.A, Italy. Separately, Tata Steel deployed Paul Wurth Coke Oven Gas (COG) Injection Technology at Meramandali blast furnace (SMS group partnership) to reduce coke consumption.
technology.problem_solved: National Green Hydrogen Mission needs ~350 KT of H2-compatible pipe over 5–7 years. Existing oil-and-gas pipes are not certified for hydrogen embrittlement. COG injection cuts coke use ~10% and CO2 emissions.
technology.innovation_summary: End-to-end indigenous: from steel design to pipe manufacturing, all in-house at Tata Steel R&D. ₹11,000 Cr committed to green steel technology.
technology.unique_selling_points: First Indian company; full indigenous chain; Welspun Corp partnership for execution; 250+ AI models in operations
technology.application_area: Hydrogen transportation infrastructure; green steel manufacturing; oil & gas adjacencies
technology.target_industries: Green hydrogen developers (NTPC, Reliance, Adani), national pipeline operators, refineries
technology.potential_customers: GAIL, Indian Oil, NTPC Renewable Energy, hydrogen project developers, IH2A consortium members
technology.patent_status: Multiple filings (steel grade composition, processing route)
technology.dsir_recognition_status: Yes — Tata Steel R&D is DSIR-recognised in-house unit
technology.estimated_market_size: 350 KT of H2-compatible pipe over 5–7 years (Tata Steel estimate)
technology.preferred_license_type: Patent Buyout (high-value process IP, exclusive sector deals possible)
technology.certification_status: Hydrogen qualification by RINA-CSM Italy; API 5L standards; BIS IS 3589; ISO 9001/14001/45001
